claim: Upgrading the vision-language LLM backbone to a more capable version (e.g., from Qwen2-VL to Qwen2.5-VL) improves generation quality in sounding video generation tasks, with the gain most pronounced in the generation task.
falsifier: The relationship can be tested by comparing generation quality metrics (e.g., AV quality, semantic consistency, AV synchrony) of a unified model when using a weaker vs stronger vision-language LLM backbone under identical training and evaluation conditions.

conditions: the backbone is used within a unified framework that also performs comprehension tasks
the comparison is between Qwen2-VL and Qwen2.5-VL backbones
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task (sounding video generation), and backbone pair (Qwen2-VL vs Qwen2.5-VL); transfer beyond these is unestablished.
